# A comment above a parenthesised operand prevents the rewrite, as it does
# without the parentheses.
celfmt -s -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

celfmt -s -i trailing.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_trailing.txt

-- src.cel --
has(state.x.f) ?
	// this comment prevents a re-write
	(
		state.x.f
	)
:
	"default"
-- want.txt --
has(state.x.f) ?
	// this comment prevents a re-write
	state.x.f
:
	"default"
-- trailing.cel --
has(state.x.f) ?
	(  // this comment prevents a re-write
		state.x.f
	)
:
	"default"
-- want_trailing.txt --
has(state.x.f) ?
	// this comment prevents a re-write
	state.x.f
:
	"default"
